Subject: P1 after-hours: high tail latency / no on-call response

Hi Soojin,

We had a pretty serious incident earlier this evening (around 17:40 PT) where latency for our inference calls spiked to 12–18s for a sustained 20 minute window. Our monitoring flagged it as a P1 and we attempted to reach the on-call number listed in the playbook, but we didn't get a response for ~65 minutes. This caused a partial degradation of our live product and a handful of customer complaints.

I know your standard P1 SLA is during business hours, but given this is a paying production customer (we're on a committed plan, DEAL-7832), we need to understand whether Redwood can commit to an after-hours escalation path for the next 30 days while we complete our migration. Specifically:
- Can we get a guaranteed on-call acknowledgement within 30 minutes outside of normal Redwood support hours?
- If not, can you provide a temporary escalation route (a direct escalation number and a named on-call engineer) and a rollback policy if the change increases cost?

I've attached our incident log (incident-log-20270615.txt) and a short timeline. Please escalate internally and let me know proposed remediation and timeline.

Thanks,
Tom Miller
Head of Platform
Greystone Analytics
